description: A trip through several countries (max 5): one Flat per country, each quoted at the same speed and days unless given per country. days is PER COUNTRY, never the whole trip: for a 12-day trip through Japan and Thailand pass per_country days that add up to 12 (e.g. 7 + 5). Returns one line per country with price and buy_url, plus the total. Use when the customer names two or more countries and a speed (2–5 destinations); for one country call quote_flat; use recommend_config when they describe devices or usage instead.

bucket.description: Optional language-region bucket the customer shops in, e.g. en-gb, de-de (sets currency and link locale). Defaults from language.

days.description: Days in EACH country (1–30, default 7) — NOT the length of the whole trip. A 12-day trip through 3 countries is about 4 days per country: split the trip with per_country days that add up to the trip length.

destinations.description: Countries of the trip (2–5), any language or ISO codes, in travel order.

language.description: ISO language of the conversation, e.g. en, de, ja. Localizes country names and sets the language/currency of links and prices.

mbps.description: Maximum speed in Mbps (5, 10, 25, 50; default 5). Data is unlimited at that speed. 25 Mbps and up need a 5G network.

per_country.description: Optional overrides per country (days and/or mbps). Use it to split the trip: the days of all countries together should add up to the trip length.

name: plan_trip
title: Plan a multi-country trip
